component.name: T48 Programmer
component.summary: Program EPROMs, EEPROMs and flash with an XGecu T48

description.p: A native GNOME interface for the XGecu T48 chip programmer, built on minipro. It reads, writes, verifies, erases and blank checks every chip minipro supports, identifies Amiga Kickstart, Atari TOS and Acorn ROM images before they are written, and guides a ROM from the image to verified chips by splitting, byte-swapping and filling it for the chips of a particular board.

ul.li: Read, write, verify, blank check and erase any chip in the minipro database, with every minipro option available.
Identify Kickstart, TOS and Acorn sideways ROM images, including a Kickstart checksum test.
A guided ROM burn for Amiga Kickstart, Atari TOS and Acorn ROMs, with several Acorn ROMs to a chip and support for encrypted Amiga Forever Kickstarts.
Test logic ICs and static RAM, read chip IDs, detect SPI flash, and run the programmer self test.
